call.t: Nano and advanced technologies for developing Diagnostic tools to improve the detection and the clinical management of non-communicable diseases - NanoDiagNCD
rs: This call is run by its organiser, who sets the eligibility rules. Check the call page.
call.x: Project proposals should address multidisciplinary research. The aim of this call is to support translational research projects that develop application(s) of nanotechnologies, either solely or in combination with Key Enabling Technologies (KETs), to make significant strides in the development of diagnostic and theranostic tools for Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs). Proposals should focus on developing and/or validating diagnostic and theranostic tools that are grounded in robust scientific evidence. The results obtained from these tools must enable the optimisation of the care continuum. This care continuum includes, among other things, prevention, early disease detection, disease...
n: This is a call run by an EU-funded project (financial support to third parties), not by the Commission. The organiser sets the rules.

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
